static_traits.name: 陈康
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and two siblings
static_traits.social_status: 家庭成员总体支持，但因烘焙失败后易烦躁使Family relationships一度紧张；担心被评判而not yet与家人分享相关感受
static_traits.medical_history: without明显躯体疾病；过往not yet接受心理治疗；此前not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能描述自己的情绪与想法；配合度Good；Neutral attitude；能识do not并描述自动化思维（如“我永远not会成为一个好的烘焙者”）

basic_info.main_problem: 最近一直感到自己not够好，并对自己的烘焙skill产生怀疑。这一切始于一次纸杯蛋糕have not达到Anticipation的甜度。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not足感和Self-doubt正在影响我对烘焙的享受和整体幸福感，因此我决定寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 约一月前一次烘焙失误（纸杯蛋糕not如Anticipation甜）引发强烈的挫败感与not足感；此后每次烘焙或想到烘焙都会出现自我批评与失望的循环，逐渐削弱了对烘焙的兴趣与信心；因担心被家人评判而not yet分享相关感受，Family relationships亦因烘焙失败后的易怒而受影响。

core_beliefs: 我永远not会成为一个好的烘焙者

special_situations.event: 一次纸杯蛋糕成品比Anticipation更not甜的烘焙结果
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连简单的纸杯蛋糕都做not好，就说明我have not能力，not可能成为好烘焙者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复更换食谱、观看大量烘焙教程、尝试更严格地按配方操作以弥补“能力not足”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次失败证明我not行，我永远not会成为一个好的烘焙者

special_situations.event: Each time starting to bake or merely thinking of baking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再失败一次，就证明我一直在浪费时间，显示我not适合烘焙
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids baking or reduces attempts, to avoid experiencing failure and shame again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我又要失败了，根本not值得再试

special_situations.event: Thinking of telling family about baking setbacks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他们知道我失败了，就会评判我、看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 隐瞒not谈、与家人保持距离以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible

special_situations.event: When facing more complex baking tasks or evaluating whether to try a harder recipe
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连简单的都做not好，就说明我完全not行，做复杂的更have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing only on failure, giving up higher-difficulty attempts to avoid being frustrated again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 连简单的都not会，更do not提复杂的了

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as a capable individual who is worthy of being accepted, and experiencing competence and joy in baking
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败后被评判、羞耻和被negate，进而证明自己“根本not行”
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being judged by avoiding exposure of failure and self-criticism
Maintains surface self-esteem and sense of safety, avoids facing shame

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、随时可能失败的学习者/烘焙者
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh, judgmental others (imagined family members / bystanders)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites deeper exploration and changing of negative thoughts and proposes behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为“这些想法很固定，谈也not用”，倾向以理性讨论替代情绪体验
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以冷静、分析性的语气强调方法是否有效，弱化情绪体验，提出诸如“我not确定谈这些有什么用”的观点。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing whether to share baking setbacks with family, or topics involving others' evaluations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的自我批评体验外归因为“他们会看not起我/评判我”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以防御性的口吻陈述“They will think I am terrible”，避免提供具体证据或进一步探讨。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在烘焙失败后与家人互动
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对自身失败的挫败与羞耻Displacement为对外部的易怒与not耐
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气短促、容易not耐烦，话语中带有隐性指责或冷淡回应，减少自我感受的暴露。

manifestations: 在想“如果连简单纸杯蛋糕都做not好，做更复杂的有什么意义？”时感到失去动力
The original joy of baking is replaced by failure experiences, hard to gain meaning and satisfaction from it
outcomes: Enjoyment of daily activities decreases; eating rhythms are affected

manifestations: 担心被家人评判而not分享烘焙相关的情绪与困扰
Emotionally shuts down after failure; reduces help-seeking and connection
outcomes: Tense family relationships、可用支持减少

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁Self-denial（如“我not行”“我永远做not好”）
对改变持怀疑（“我not认为谈话能改变这些想法”），对自我要求苛刻、难以接纳not完美

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turning the frustration after failure toward self-criticism rather than seeking external support
担心被评判而Suppressing expression与求助的需求

positive_force: 家人总体支持（虽暂not yet分享，但可作为潜在支持资源）
Once gained enjoyment from baking, with intrinsic interest and motivation
Able to proactively seek improvement methods (changing recipes, watching tutorials)
Work performance is stable; daily functioning basically maintained
negative_force: 非黑即白与过度概括等负性思维模式ReinforcementSelf-denial
预测not yet来与读心术使其在not yet求证时便预设失败或他人评判
担心被评判导致回避分享与求助，Insufficient use of social support
失败后易怒，造成Tense family relationships，进一步加重负性循环
Self-doubt导致饮食节律与活动兴趣受损

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance related to baking and strong self-criticism
antecedent: Before starting baking or just thinking of baking
回忆起纸杯蛋糕not够甜的经历
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次失败视为能力的全盘negate（过度概括、非黑即白与灾难化倾向），以回避失败来保护自尊与降低羞耻
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与被评判的可能性，短期降低Anxiety与羞耻
target_behavior.consequence: 减少练习机会、对烘焙失去兴趣，Self-efficacy下降，负性情绪维持

target_behavior.behavior: 烘焙失败后对家人的易怒与not耐烦
antecedent: 烘焙结果not达Anticipation后与家人接触
target_behavior.core_reason: 将对自我失败的挫败与羞耻Displacement至他人（防御性Displacement）
target_behavior.function: Short-term release of tension; avoids directly facing self-blame and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Tense family relationships，支持系统的可用性降低，负性循环加剧

target_behavior.behavior: 饮食节律紊乱（因Self-doubt导致进食减少或not规律）
target_behavior.core_reason: 将注意力过度聚焦于“证明能力/避免失败”，忽视身体需求，以控制来对抗without力感
target_behavior.function: Temporarily gains a sense of control, avoids painful emotions related to failure
target_behavior.consequence: 身心状态与日常活动的Reduced sense of enjoyment，恢复力减弱
